criteria.requirement: Add tenacity.stop.stop_before_idle_budget(budget) as stop_base. Accept nonnegative finite seconds or timedelta, rejecting booleans/nonfinite/negative values. Stop when retry_state.idle_for + upcoming_sleep is greater than or equal to budget, before that next sleep is issued. Count only retry waiting, not target execution elapsed time; a zero budget stops after the first rejected attempt even for zero wait. Integrate with actual Retrying and AsyncRetrying and stop_any/stop_all without storing mutable per-call counters in the shared policy. Preserve other stop and wait semantics.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
